name: qualai-project
description: QualAI - AI-powered quality assurance platform with FastAPI backend and React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:landing: echo 'Landing page is already built (static HTML)'
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env
scripts.clean: npm run clean:docker && npm run clean:node
scripts.clean:node: cd client && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && cd .. && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup

author: QualAI Team
